answer: The orchard keeper knows every tree by the graft he set himself, and he walks the rows before the fruit is picked. Proof of bell founder mould via bronze pour record is the walking: a bell the founder casts only after the pour record lists 5 ladles of bronze, each weighed at the furnace mouth. The marble is the graft, set in the spring; the beacon is the row, walked at harvest. Faking the orchard takes a cheat 37 false grafts and 37 false rows, and the grove still bears no fruit on his branches.
